Callout.Name: Unlicensed Tour Group
Callout.Message: Group being led through a protected area.
Callout.Advisory: Guide with twelve people, no permit.

Script.Line: Twelve of them and a guide, all well off the marked path.
They are paying for it, that is why he does it.
They are heading for the falls, and the falls are closed.

Lines.Approach: Twelve of them following somebody with no permit. Nobody is in danger, it is just the wrong place for it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
